invariants.rule: Only a verified WeChat callback or authoritative query may confirm an external WeChat payment.
invariants.verification: Payment callback/query signature tests and settlement integration tests

invariants.rule: Payable amount and merchant/shop scope are server-owned and must not be trusted from a client.
invariants.verification: Server-side payable amount and multi-shop merchant binding tests

invariants.rule: Payment and refund success application is idempotent and must produce immutable accounting evidence.
invariants.verification: Duplicate callback/refund tests and ledger consistency checks

invariants.rule: Cloud is the sole KDS business authority; cashier is proxy/cache only.
invariants.verification: KDS authority-mode, command-contract and legacy-write fail-closed tests

invariants.rule: Adding dishes must preserve the original order creation time.
invariants.verification: Add-dish regression tests assert order_time is unchanged

invariants.rule: Every successful business mutation of an order must monotonically increase its revision.
invariants.verification: Concurrent command and stale expectedVersion tests

invariants.rule: Final payable amount is produced by server-owned pricing rules and never by a client-provided total.
invariants.verification: Price tampering, quote and settlement parity tests

invariants.rule: A table outstanding amount equals the sum of authoritative net payable amounts of all unsettled orders for the same shop and table.
invariants.verification: Table/order amount parity tests covering add dish, merge, discount and refund

invariants.rule: A combo header carries the price; component lines are persisted for traceability and must not be priced again.
invariants.verification: Combo expansion, parent linkage and no-double-charge tests

invariants.rule: An approval token is bound to exactly one action, resource, amount, operator and shop and can be consumed only once.
invariants.verification: Binding mismatch, expiry and concurrent single-consumption tests
